gaps.why_needed: Blocks EPS, current P/E, forward P/E, PEG, P/S, market cap, and both candidate Entry Price V1 methods -- no per-share or market-value metric can be computed without it.
gaps.approx_required_history: Same 5-year window already covered by Annual/Quarterly Data V1 (2019/2020-2026) for the same 9 tickers -- no new filings need to be fetched, only re-extraction of an existing XBRL tag from filings already locked.
gaps.notes: Lowest-risk, highest-leverage gap to close -- uses the already-proven statement-first XBRL extraction pipeline, not a new provider.

gaps.gap: Analyst consensus data (ratings, coverage count, rating changes, price targets, forward EPS estimates)
gaps.why_needed: Needed for Analyst trend, Target-price gap, Forward P/E, PEG, and Entry Price Method 2.
gaps.approx_required_history: Full 5-year backtest window, ideally as true as-of-date historical snapshots (not today's restated consensus).
gaps.notes: Hardest gap to close safely for backtesting -- most providers expose only current consensus, which would introduce look-ahead bias if used retroactively. Provider evaluation explicitly out of scope for this task.

gaps.gap: Sector / industry classification for each company
gaps.why_needed: Needed for a true 'Relative to industry' valuation/growth factor.
gaps.approx_required_history: None -- current classification is largely static and sufficient.
gaps.notes: Partially mitigated already: Scoring Model V1's within-universe percentile-rank scoring gives every factor a relative-to-peers flavor, just not a true sector-relative one. Becomes more important once the universe expands beyond 9 companies.

gaps.gap: Benchmark index historical daily prices (S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, relevant industry benchmarks)
gaps.why_needed: Needed to measure excess return, drawdown, and hit rate versus benchmark in the eventual backtest, per docs/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md Backtesting requirements.
gaps.approx_required_history: Same 5-year window as the company price data.
gaps.notes: Not needed to compute company scores or entry prices -- only needed at the final backtest-evaluation stage (Stage 6, step 5), which is explicitly not built in this task.
